simulator_note: Vendor GDB simulator stopped with SIGILL; no full reset/QSPI simulation pass claimed
baseline_user_report: User confirmed prior VOICE_STANDALONE_R1 Flash boot works
fix: Separate non-darkening hue-preserving fill from one-sided structural black contours; remove independent RGB quantization, wide half-color ink and post-ink blur blend.

baseline_release: TOON_R3 retained as rollback, user reports color/outline defects

latency_measurement.end: first valid RGB pixel sampled at HDMI TX input, after display mixer
latency_measurement.samples: first valid display of each unique source; startup/resync first source primes identity

hardware_acceptance.scope: User confirmed TOON_R4 real-board pass after successful Flash programming on 2026-10-26. This is not a claim that every competition requirement was separately accepted.

predecessor_hardware_result: User reports unclear contours, gray becoming black and white becoming gray; location not certain. Code reproduces wide ink darkening and exaggerated near-neutral channel differences.

toon_parameters.fill_luminance_contract: Fill luminance never below the edge-preserving-smoothed source; contour pixels excluded.
toon_parameters.gamut_policy: Use candidate only if common lift fits all channels, otherwise original RGB plus limited positive common lift
toon_parameters.saturated_primary_protection: min <=8 and max >=224 preserve original RGB
toon_parameters.contour_method: one-sided local curvature selected by dominant Sobel direction
